name: Chathurya Sandabarana
secondary: Aerospace Engineering in the UK, First Class Honours.
description: Chathurya Sandabarana is a Sri Lankan singer from Tangalle. The Voice Sri Lanka Live Shows, international recognition on The Voice Global, concerts across Sri Lanka and in Dubai, and an Aerospace Engineering degree with First Class Honours from the UK.
formats: Concerts in Sri Lanka and overseas
availability: Available for concerts, musical shows, school and community events across Sri Lanka and overseas.
